تنتحرن (form VIII)
# تَنْتَحِرْنَ (tantaḥirna) /tan.ta.ħir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# تُنْتَحَرْنَ (tuntaḥarna) /tun.ta.ħar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
